notes.title: Our new card puzzle game Playing Prague is out! 🌞
notes.content:
[p]Hello and happy last weeks of springs,[/p][p]we have an [b]big announcement: a new game – and it includes Kafka, as well![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Y0kvdbimI3c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s called [b]Playing Prague[/b] and design-wise, it follows in Beecarbonize’s footsteps. Playing Prague is a cozy puzzler, where you build your own bohemian city by placing cards with symbols from historical houses of Prague. It’s a challenge for both casual and experienced puzzle fans and during gameplay, you’ll also learn something about Prague, its history and important personalities like Mozart, Einstein or Kafka tied with it.[/p][p][b]Thanks to a partnership with city agency Prague City Tourism, it is 100% free.[/b][/p][h3]
🌞 [url="https://prague.eu/en/playing-prague/"]Play it now on iOS and Android.[/url][/h3][p]
We wanted to pay tribute to the city we live in and love. Inspired by cozy city-builder games, this mobile-first title is both a logical challenge as well as an atmospheric experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382788/f27ba0003923c28d5037c8d09da9961b3bd42fd8.gif"][/img][/p][p]It’s a relaxing puzzle game in which Prague comes alive. Discover the bohemian city and make it your own by creating your own little Prague – all the while solving game levels by placing cards with ancient symbols from Prague houses. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382788/0b8c946f0bc8a985489ac19fbab66e4a69eaa5e1.gif"][/img][/p][p]And if you try it out, let us know how you like the game – preferably by leaving a review on the stores. Thanks for playing![/p][p]
All the best,[/p][p]Ondřej
Charles Games[/p]

notes.title: Our New Game Velvet 89 is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Our very dear Kafka players,
We are trilled to announce that our new game [b]Velvet 89[/b] is out now!
[/h3]

Knowing how much you loved the distinctive art style of Playing Kafka, we designed Velvet 89 with visuals that will capture your attention through a detailed exploration of late 1980s fashion and aesthetics! The game’s paper-like style is inspired by the transparency of banners and placards used by protesters during the revolution, blending historical accuracy with artistic flair to immerse you in the spirit of the era.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133340/Velvet_89/

[b]Velvet 89 is a free game that will take you to the streets of several Czechoslovak cities, full of people who decided to speak up against an unjust regime – and a title attentive to some of the overlooked aspects of it all.[/b]

[previewyoutube=b-Uswx95FoM;full][/previewyoutube]

We'd love to hear your thoughts! Leave us a review, drop a comment, and share your perspective on the power of protests—how they have shaped history and how they continue to inspire change today.

Velvet 89 is also available on both phone and tablet devices, on App Store and Google Play so you can explore it on whichever platform you prefer. Dive in and experience the story wherever you are!

notes.title: Meet our next game: Velvet 89! ✌️
notes.content:
Our very dear Playing Kafka players,
I am so happy to announce a [b]new game by Charles Games coming in October 2024![/b] 

[b]Velvet 89 is a free game that will take you to the streets of several Czechoslovak cities, full of people who decided to speak up against an unjust regime – and a title attentive to some of the overlooked aspects of it all.[/b]

[previewyoutube=d9j-1URhyCI;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s twice a first for Charles Games – a hidden-object game (we just love Hidden Folks) and a game about perhaps the most significant topic our country’s history in the last 35 years: The Velvet Revolution! We will let our new Steam page (including teaser!) to speak for itself:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133340/Velvet_89/

With Velvet 89 we put a lot of effort into a) making sure the history is represented in a nuanced and truthful manner and b) stylized visuals with a paper-like quality to them. 

You’ll be the judge of how successful we were in the fall, but until then, spread the word, wishlist (it helps) and look forward to the 35th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution with us and Velvet 89.

notes.title: Playing Kafka reached 70 000 players!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it is with a great pleasure that I can report that across all the platforms we have reached another milestone: 70 000 activations of the game! And nearly half of those came from Steam, so thank you so much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972519/ac663f38d3c10257f80a4113899671f442c58447.jpg[/img]

If you like what were doing, check out our other games – a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2486750/Beecarbonize/?curator_clanid=34998449]climate strategy[/url], a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/676630/Attentat_1942/?curator_clanid=34998449]historical adventure[/url] set in WW2 or[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076620/Svoboda_1945_Liberation/?curator_clanid=34998449] another one[/url] taking place after WW2. We are happy and much obliged!
Ondřej
Charles Games

notes.title: Playing Kafka hits 30 000 activations 🎉
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
[b]Thank you so much for being our players – we hit thirty thousand players across all platforms![/b] And more than two thirds came from Steam :) So we are much obliged for your interest, a case in point that absurdist narrative adventures do have a place in the current game landscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972519/2e6a2700a720832ed9a1a84cd7d3d03d01a0586f.jpg[/img]

We’re also very grateful for all your reviews and impressions – keep them coming! Not only we read all player comments, but each review helps us get Playing Kafka in front of more eyes due to how Steam algorithm works. So – if you liked the game, leave a review!

Here’s our team happy from how you all like Playing Kafka (during the game’s launch):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972519/78faa2648113e0123af22c8b8c7e7c79100281d0.jpg[/img] 

So thanks a lot and if you want to be updated for all Charles Games things, consider joining our newsletter or Discord. We have a nice community there, I think.

For all of us at Charles Games,
Ondřej

notes.title: Playing Kafka is out now! 🪲
notes.content:
The moment is now: [b]Playing Kafka is officially released![/b] Happy playing, everyone!

A big thanks goes to you, our community, for playing, wishlisting, talking about our games. Playing Kafka would not have happened without you. And we wouldn’t be releasing a Kafka game now without our partners at Goethe-institut, Prague and their Kafka experts. Huge thanks belongs to all the voice actors who brought the characters into life. Playing Kafka might be a free game, but it is a title we hold dear to our hearts. We hope this care is felt in the final game.

Thank you for playing. We can’t wait to read what you think! So, leave a review. It helps to boost the game’s visibility and it’s a valuable feedback for all of us at Charles Games. Much obliged!

See you at the Castle!

Ondřej
and the rest of the team
